catches: You must pass a screening survey and researcher review before each session; invitations typically run 1-3 per month.
Researchers initiate payment after your session, so the 5-7 business day window only starts once the session is complete and verified.
In-person sessions pay more ($100-$300+) but require travel to major metros; online sessions pay $75-$200.
No junk surveys or marketing lists, but also no guarantee of study volume.

steps: Create a free participant profile at respondent.io (90-second signup, identity verified once).
Browse open focus-group studies; select 'Start Screener' on ones you fit.
Answer screening questions; researcher reviews and invites qualifying participants.
Attend the 60-90 minute moderated session online (or in person).
Receive payment via Tremendous, usually within 5-7 business days after your session.
timing: Paid via Tremendous, usually within 5-7 business days after your session (official focus-group page).

maximize: Fill out your Respondent professional profile in full — researchers screen by job title, industry, and demographics, and studies are matched to your background. Apply to new studies immediately; they fill fast. Online focus-group sessions typically pay $75-$200 for 60-90 minutes, paid via Tremendous usually within 5-7 business days. Complete every session you book — you only get paid for sessions you qualify for and complete.
who_pays: The researcher running the study pays you — payment is initiated through Respondent’s payment provider, Tremendous, once your session is complete and verified.
who_qualifies: 18+ with a computer or tablet with webcam, microphone and stable internet (or the ability to attend in person in a major metro). You need a free participant profile with one-time identity verification.
work_available: Open marketplace but competitive — browse open studies and apply; they fill fast, and you typically see 1–3 invitations a month. No guaranteed volume.
what_gets_accepted: You must pass the study’s screening survey and researcher review, then attend and complete the session. You only get paid for sessions you qualify for and complete.
costs_and_unpaid_time: Free to join — never asked to pay. Unpaid time: screening surveys for each study, waiting on researcher review, and travel time if you choose in-person sessions (which pay $100–$300+ in major metros).
when_cash_arrives: Via Tremendous, usually within 5–7 business days after your session — the window starts once your session is complete and verified.
